source_title: Project Vaayu: Kulhad-based eco coolers for classrooms
raw_description: In Delhi, six Class 10 students turned discarded kulhads into eco coolers for schools with tin roofs. Using clay cooling, scrap metal, and simple motors, Project Vaayu reduced classroom temperatures by 6 to 8 degrees Celsius and helped over 400 children across four schools stay comfortable during extreme heat.
